purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance claim (receipt) processing system - monthly aggregate/summary report for medical claims (診療報酬総括表)
purpose.summary: SOKATU4400 is a batch program in the JMA ORCA medical receipt software suite. It generates a monthly aggregate summary report (総括表) for medical insurance claims, reading from a temporary indexed file and producing an update file and error file. It handles hospital information lookup, date conversion, and multi-page printing logic.

notable_features: 43 CALL statements including ORCSJOB and other ORCA subsystem routines
INDEXED file with DYNAMIC access mode
UNSTRING of COMMAND-PARAM for parameter passing
REDEFINES usage for hospital name/address fields
Japanese text in comments (EUC-JP or Shift-JIS encoded, rendered as latin-1 mojibake)
Revision history embedded in comments with version numbers
LINKAGE SECTION with COMMAND-PARAM for shell invocation
verdict.notes: Source file contains Japanese text encoded in EUC-JP or Shift-JIS, decoded as latin-1 resulting in mojibake in comments. This is clearly part of the well-known JMA ORCA open-source medical receipt system. Source truncated at 16000 chars out of 68811 bytes total; full program logic not visible but structure is clear. Fixed format with a few lines slightly over 72 chars (5 long lines noted).
